claims.claim_ar: أَلَمْ: همزة الاستفهام للتعجب مع لام نفي (لم) — تركيب استفهامي تعجبي سلبي لا تُستعاد جميع دقته في ترجمة بسيطة.
claims.claim_en: A lam-prefixed interrogative: the hamza marks an exclamatory question and the lam is the negating particle (lam of negation). The combination produces a negative-exclamatory sense ('Have you not.../Did you not...'), a nuance that is often compressed or lost in simple translations.

claims.claim_ar: تَرَ: فعل مضارع مجزوم بلم (جزم الفعل المضارع بسبب لم) — هنا يحمل معنى الاستمرارية/الاطّلاع في صيغة الاستفهام التعجبي.
claims.claim_en: tarā: present-tense verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is governed by lam (negation in the negative-interrogative). This verb-form flavour (jussive after lam) affects verb endings and the pragmatic reading ('Have you not seen...').

claims.claim_ar: إِلَى: حرف جر هنا متعلق بالفعل «تَرَ» (إلى الذين) — nuance: marks the target/scope ('with regard to those who...') which can be rendered in English with several prepositional choices.
claims.claim_en: ilā: preposition marking the target/scope (here linking to 'those who'); the nuance ('to/regarding/upon those who') may be rendered variously in translation and some subtlety may be lost.
claims.needs_review_reason: prepositional scope/translation nuance can be analyzed differently depending on syntactic attachment; source commentary gives phrasing but not exhaustive semantic analysis.

claims.claim_ar: الَّذِينَ: اسم موصول للجمع المذكر، بمعنى «الذين/أولئك الذين» (دلالة تعريفية على من يشار إليهم).
claims.claim_en: alladhīna: relative pronoun 'those who' (masculine plural) — introduces the group being referred to ('those who were given a share of the Scripture').
